mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Overcast skies cover the city with a current temperature of 49 degrees near Fireman's Park, feeling a bit cooler at 42. Under a waning crescent moon tonight, temperatures will fall to an overnight low of 47 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, Verona officially welcomed Liz Gay as the new EMS Deputy Chief of Administration this week. Additionally, Public Works announced that asphalt repair contractors will be milling and patching several city streets, including Nine Mound Road and Mozart Street, on November 9th and 10th.

Local events featured today include live music at Paddy Mac's and Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead to tomorrow, ART House 360 kicks off its Thursday night entertainment series in Verona.

In the police recap, on Thursday, October 22nd, officers responded to a vehicle collision involving a Metro Bus on West Verona Avenue near Todd Street, where a driver was cited for failure to yield the right of way.
Culver's is open tonight until 10:00 PM, featuring Dark Chocolate PB Crunch as today's Flavor of the Day. Tomorrow's featured flavor will be Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
